newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Six Viet boatpeople stage breakout from HK camp.
newsitem.headline: Six Viet boatpeople stage breakout from HK camp.

text.p: Six Vietnamese boatpeople staged a breakout from a Hong Kong detention camp on Friday, the British colony's government said.
Four had been captured by police and two were still missing, a government information service officer told Reuters.
Police were sweeping the hills around the Whitehead detention centre in Hong Kong's rural New Territories for the two escapees, the officer said.
She said guards at the centre had quickly alerted police about the breakout.
Last year, the Whitehead camp was the scene of a massive breakout and rioting.
